title: echidnopsis scutellata subsp. planiflora
intro: Echidnopsis scutellata subsp. planiflora, commonly known as the "Mandevilla," is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical regions of Africa and Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, Echidnopsis scutellata subsp. planiflora has been reported to exhibit sedative and antispasmodic actions, which may help to alleviate anxiety and muscle spasms. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
